messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Time series data in v1.11.0
parts:
Please use argument save_ms5rawlevels

Also, consider updating to version 2.0 as the time series output has improved in that version. There are still some minor bugs that will be addressed in the next GitHub-only release later this week. Which can be installed with the install_github("wadpac/GGIR") comment I probably have mentioned in other messages. If I do not receive issue reports on that this will be part of the next CRAN release in July.

Thanks,
Vincent
‐‐‐‐‐‐‐ Original Message ‐‐‐‐‐‐‐
On Monday 25 May 2020 11:16, Bridge <birdmc...@gmail.com> wrote:

Hello

Is it possible to extract time series data from GGIR v1.11.0? Based on all of the output files, I can see total time spent in physical activity levels but how do I export this into a .csv and have physical activity levels labelled by time?

Thanks!
